name: Si Suthammaracha
contribution: The King of Ayutthaya from August 1656 to 26 October 1656.

checks.lead: Si Suthammaracha (Thai: ศรีสุธรรมราชา, Śrī Sudharmarājā) was the King of Ayutthaya from August 1656 to 26 October 1656 (2 months 17 Days). He was a younger brother of Prasat Thong.
checks.photo: no death year in or after 1860
